name: Exp_Kolier_SuperTrend_X2
summary: This EA implements a dual SuperTrend indicator strategy for trend-following trading. It uses two SuperTrend indicators with different periods/multipliers to generate entry signals when both align in the same direction, and exits when either SuperTrend flips direction. The system applies the ATR-based SuperTrend logic to capture medium-to-long-term trends while filtering out noise through the double confirmation mechanism.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双重SuperTrend指标策略进行趋势跟踪交易。通过两个不同参数的SuperTrend指标同向确认来产生入场信号，当任一SuperTrend翻转时出场。系统利用基于ATR的SuperTrend逻辑捕捉中长期趋势，同时通过双重确认机制过滤噪音。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重SuperTrend指标的趋势跟踪系统，两个SuperTrend指标使用不同的周期和乘数参数，当两者同向看多时做多，同向看空时做空。入场条件要求两个SuperTrend指标方向一致才产生信号，这提供了更强的趋势确认过滤，减少了假突破和震荡行情中的误交易。出场条件是当任一SuperTrend指标方向翻转时即平仓，这种宽松的出场机制确保在趋势可能反转时尽早退出。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面包含止损设置，但SuperTrend本身的ATR机制已经内置了动态止损特性。整体策略逻辑清晰，双重确认机制有效降低了假信号，但也可能在趋势初期延迟入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual SuperTrend indicator trend-following system where two SuperTrend indicators with different periods and multipliers are used simultaneously. Entry conditions require both SuperTrend indicators to align in the same direction — a long signal is generated when both turn bullish, and a short signal when both turn bearish, providing stronger trend confirmation and filtering out false breakouts in choppy markets. Exit conditions trigger when either SuperTrend indicator flips direction, which ensures early exit when a trend reversal may be forming. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and equity-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management includes stop loss configuration, though the SuperTrend's inherent ATR-based mechanism already provides dynamic stop loss functionality. The overall strategy logic is clear, and the dual confirmation mechanism effectively reduces false signals, though it may cause delayed entries at the beginning of new trends.

parameters.name: MagicNumber

pros: 双重SuperTrend确认机制有效过滤假信号，提高入场质量
基于ATR的动态止损适应市场波动率变化，在不同行情下自适应调整
策略逻辑清晰简洁，参数可调性强，便于优化和适应不同品种
pros_en: Dual SuperTrend confirmation effectively filters false signals and improves entry quality
ATR-based dynamic stop loss adapts to market volatility changes, self-adjusting across different market conditions
Clear and concise strategy logic with highly adjustable parameters, easy to optimize for different instruments
cons: 双重确认导致趋势初期入场延迟，可能错过趋势的起始部分利润
在震荡行情中仍可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损
缺少资金管理模块如最大回撤控制和每日亏损限制
cons_en: Dual confirmation causes delayed entry at trend inception, potentially missing the initial portion of trend profit
May still generate frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks advanced money management modules such as maximum drawdown control and daily loss limits
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤指标（如ADX）避免在弱趋势震荡行情中频繁开仓
添加移动止盈和部分平仓机制以更好地锁定趋势利润
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to avoid frequent entries during weak trend or ranging conditions
Implement trailing take-profit and partial close mechanisms to better lock in trend profits

risk_points: 止盈止损参数默认为0，未设置硬性止损保护可能导致单笔亏损过大
缺少最大持仓和最大回撤控制机制，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit parameters are 0, lack of hard stop protection may lead to excessive single-trade losses
No maximum position or maximum drawdown control mechanism, risk exposure is uncontrolled during extreme market conditions
